description: CsNaMo(HO₂)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. Cs is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one H and six O atoms. The Cs-H bond length is 3.24 Å. There are a spread of Cs-O bond distances ranging from 2.95-3.48 Å. Na is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four H and two equivalent O atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.58-2.68 Å. There is one shorter (2.23 Å) and one longer (2.24 Å) Na-O bond length. Mo is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are three shorter (1.79 Å) and one longer (1.85 Å) Mo-O bond length. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Cs and two equivalent Na atoms. In the second H site, H is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na atoms. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Cs and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Cs and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Cs, two equivalent Na, and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Cs and one Mo atom.
